orgSettings.title: Organization settings
orgSettings.hint: Brand color, public domain and payment provider (stored in organization_settings).
orgSettings.brandColorHint: Hex (#RGB or #RRGGBB). Leave empty for the default theme.
orgSettings.logoHint: PNG / JPEG / WebP, 512 KB max. Shown in portal headers.
orgSettings.faviconHint: ICO / PNG / WebP, 128 KB max. Browser tab icon.
orgSettings.assetError: Failed to upload or remove the asset.
orgSettings.domainHint: Public host (e.g. visa.acme.com), no https://. Empty = no domain resolution. See docs/WHITE_LABEL.md for DNS/TLS.
orgSettings.domainInvalid: Invalid domain — host only, no path.
orgSettings.paymentProviderHint: The payment.provider.* feature flag must also be enabled for Stripe / CinetPay / PayDunya.
orgSettings.saveError: Could not save. Check the values and your permissions.
